attempts.summary: Configured NFS share of /srv/nfs/shared on node1, exported to node2's IP only (rw,sync,root_squash), and mounted it persistently at /mnt/shared on node2 via /etc/fstab. Created matching dataops:dataops (UID/GID 4500) identities on both nodes and set the shared directory to dataops:dataops mode 2770. Verified files created from either node preserve consistent ownership/permissions on the other. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: restarted node1 and node2 sequentially (one at a time), confirmed changed boot_id on each, and verified NFS server/export (node1) and auto-mount/data (node2) fully recovered post-restart with correct ownership and read/write access preserved.
